notes.title: Playtest until 27 October 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Playtest Now Open![/h1]

We're excited to announce that you can now request access to the playtest for Universe Has No Favorites! This test includes the first two parts of the four-part adventure. Explore the game before anyone else and share your feedback with us.

The playtest will run until Sunday, October 27, 2024. Don't miss out on this chance to be part of our testing community!

Click "Request Access" to join the adventure.

notes.title: 2nd Steam NextFest Livestream
notes.content:
[h3]Enter the world of CYBERPUNK in an Interactive Visual science fiction Novel game![/h3]
Navigate a dangerous cyberpunk world on the edge of civilisation as an escaped prisoner with unknown brain implants in your head.
Simply click on the interactive link in the text and you can explore the environment, use and collect items and store them in your inventory. Dialogues are also an important part of the game, giving you important (and unimportant) information you need to complete the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831501/974fa1ecd957ad3f6b639241b6ba2e6cd428ac41.gif[/img]

[i]Written by legendary Czech science fiction authors: Jiří W. Procházka, the father of Czech cyberpunk, author of the Ken Wood novels, and Štěpán Kopřiva, author of the epic Asphalt, a novel in which a group of mercenaries turn hell on its head.[/i]
